title: NASA Sun fact sheet: obliquity to the ecliptic 7.25
summary: The Sun fact sheet lists obliquity to the ecliptic as 7.25.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists Obliquity to ecliptic (deg.) as 7.25 for the Sun. Listed under rotational and orbital parameters. Mass, volumetric mean radius, luminosity, spectral type, and the sidereal rotation period are on other cards and are not repeated as the claim here. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.

sources.title: Sun Fact Sheet
sources.author: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, NSSDCA
